profile.headline: Senior Software Developer
profile.summary: I'm a software developer interested in creating engaging, exciting, and useful products. I love a good challenge and have experience developing web applications across the full stack with Ruby on Rails, React, Redux, Flask, HTML/CSS, and more.

positions.title: Web Development Intern
positions.description:
Developed webpages for dailybruin.com using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
Utilized the Foundation framework and libraries such as Leaflet to present articles in an interactive and engaging manner for readers. Reviewed, edited, and uploaded articles and social media posts using WordPress.

positions.title: UCLA Cal Teach Intern
positions.description: Led group workshop activities and provided in-class mathematics tutoring for 9th and 12th grade high school students.  Effectively communicated with full classrooms of students to present lessons on algebra and discrete mathematics.  Reviewed and graded student worksheets and homework assignments.

projects.title: Tabodoro
projects.description:
A chrome extension that turns the new tab page into a pomodoro timer to boost productivity and focus.
- Devised a background script to persist user settings across sessions and maintain synchronization across all tabs
- Implemented the timer as a React component to facilitate its dynamic updating and rendering

projects.title: Litenote
projects.description:
A single-page, full-stack web app that allows users to create notes with rich-text editing, organize them into notebooks, search for notes, and add tags.
- Designed and implemented a RESTful API to interact with a PostgreSQL database
- Architected application data flow, dynamic rendering, and data store using React and Redux
- Reduced server requests by preloading session data into Redux store at login
- Implemented front-end note search
- Designed elegant UI using React, HTML, and CSS
